name: DXMag Computational HeuslerDB — ternary DFT
description: Heusler-family crystal and magnetic-property release; DFT configurations for ternary compounds.

properties: KKR Curie/Néel temperature estimates for a subset

sources.title: NIMS DXMag Computational HeuslerDB
sources.evidence: Provider lists 27,864 ternary compounds and more than 100,000 structural/magnetic entries, dates the public CSV and explicitly licenses the database CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: DXMag ternary DFT CSV
sources.evidence: Complete CSV independently contains 106,235 rows with unique UUIDs and populated cell, positions and atomic-number columns; 18,792 distinct literal composition strings. SHA-256 preserved.

caveats: 106,235 counts structural/magnetic calculation rows; it is not a unique-compound count.
Provider reports 27,864 compounds, while the public file has 18,792 literal composition strings; these denominators were not reconciled or chemically deduplicated.
Phonon, band/DOS and ordering-temperature coverage are subsets; they do not add unique structures.
Anomalous Hall/Nernst columns are currently omitted from the public CSV; the web dashboard is NIMS-network only.

additional_counts.scope: Provider family-level denominator; not reconciled to the public CSV calculation rows or literal composition strings.
Derived from the public CSV composition column; no chemical reduction or structural deduplication.

sources.title: DXMag quaternary ML CSV
sources.evidence: HTTP 206 sample confirms cell, positions and atomic-number columns; ML_cell, ML_e, Tc_ML, Phonon_ML, MAE_ML and moment fields.

sources.title: CMR repository terms

The catalog has no dedicated 1D category, so this release is placed under computed-property datasets.

name: MINT-ATLAS atomistic magnetic interactions
description: Structure-linked atomistic magnetic interaction data with downloadable interaction tables and precomputed magnetic spectra.
count_scope: Unfiltered live API meta.data_available; different records can share a formula or magnetic system.
provenance: Compiled atomistic magnetic-interaction calculations with per-record method and literature provenance
license: Not verified: client MIT license covers software; no dataset-specific license established

sources.title: MINT-ATLAS public OPTIMADE structures
sources.evidence: Unfiltered metadata reports 209 records; sample mi-0 has cell vectors, site coordinates, method and reference fields, and availability flags.

sources.title: MINT-ATLAS material/download metadata
sources.evidence: Advertises HDF5, exchange CSV and structure exports with byte counts and SHA-256 values.

sources.title: Official MINT-ATLAS client documentation
sources.evidence: Documents public token-free read-only access and explicitly identifies MIT as a client-software license; describes spectra and mean-field conventions.

caveats: The API uses 3D periodic simulation cells even for physically lower-dimensional systems.
Availability differs by record; absent interaction/spectrum fields are not zero.
Mean-field temperature is a q=0 scalar-exchange estimate, not an experimental ordering temperature or a full-Brillouin-zone ground-state search.
The first response reports data_returned=209 despite page_limit=1; the count uses meta.data_available, not page-array length.
Compiled sources can overlap other magnetic databases; the record count is not a distinct-compound deduplication.

sources.title: Altermagnetic band-splitting data release
sources.evidence: Deposits ranked/candidate spreadsheets plus collinear and converted-noncollinear MAGNDATA symmetry tables.

sources.title: Altermagnet Zenodo metadata
sources.evidence: Declares CC BY 4.0 and public downloadable files with checksums.

sources.title: Altermagnet ranked spreadsheet
sources.evidence: Independent OOXML inspection finds 171 nonempty data rows in each of two sheets; columns contain MAGNDATA/ICSD identifiers and spin-splitting properties.

caveats: This deposited ranked cohort has 171 records; the associated paper/current application describes 180 materials, so the catalog does not assign 180 to this file.
The broader candidate spreadsheet has 295 nonempty material rows and is a different denominator.
Structure identifiers establish linkage; this small Zenodo package does not independently establish release of all atomic coordinates or the claimed raw DFT calculation files.
MAGNDATA parent structures overlap the parent database; computed spin splitting is the additional content.
Forced-collinear variants do not establish stability relative to noncollinear ground states.

additional_counts.scope: Nonempty material rows in Altermagnet_HTS_Full_Candidate_Pool.xlsx; includes a broader cohort, not added to ranked count.
